_about: The 2026 season layer: one banner for the whole site, one slogan per city, and a short verified history for cities where someone has checked the facts. Slogans are voice, not facts, and never borrow a team's name, nickname or trademarked rallying cry. History facts are shown only when 'verified' is true; each block says where it was checked.

banner.line: Say it now. Mean it in February.
banner.note: Every city starts 0-0. Every fan starts certain.

history.source: Public championship-game record, cross-checked with src/data/history.json (last win 1996-01-28).
facts: Five championships in the big game, won after the 1971, 1977, 1992, 1993 and 1995 seasons.
Three of those came in four seasons, from the 1992 season through the 1995 season.
The last one was won on January 28, 1996. Every fan here has been saying this is the year ever since.
